## Parent

https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4

## What to build

Start a broadcast paste from the normal UI with one named operation, and let the existing application module own confirmation, progress, cancellation, and actual completion without caller-managed Begin/End steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Keep broadcast coordination in the application module, with production/controlled confirmation adapters and immutable request/state values. Reuse the real session input owner and existing wire seam.
- [ ] Capture immutable text, effective scope, source identity, and eligible recipient generations before preview. Deliver once per selected session, preflight all targets before payload, and preserve zero-target/no-fallback behavior, pacing, and existing budgets.
- [ ] Validate the preview answer and any remembered pacing update in one ordered transition. Cancelled preview requests closure and releases broadcast admission without awaiting inert callbacks; those callbacks cannot send, update defaults, or affect a replacement operation.
- [ ] Retire cancelled broadcast-preview busy flags so an inert dialog alone cannot block a replacement paste or otherwise eligible AI grant. Preserve independent single-session preview, IME, native capture, pending sends, and real preflight ownership.
- [ ] Distinguish Stop Paste from full Stop and Stop acknowledgement from actual cleanup completion. Show pending cleanup and retain real session/buffer ownership until it ends.
- [ ] Preserve conflicting-scope Start checks, whole-operation source/target AI exclusion including unchecked sources, ordinary per-session input after full Stop, and existing movement rules.
- [ ] Test the full UI-intent-to-bytes/results path with late answers, rejection, preflight failure, delayed writes/closure, cancellation, source movement, and stale progress. Existing gesture behavior continues to work during this migration.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body:
BroadcastInput now owns preview, recipient and source lifetime, pacing, and completion. The Release WPF/loopback tests passed late preview cancellation and replacement, stale pacing answers, cross-window recipients, zero-send encoding preflight failure, and Stop Paste during real paced transmission. Changes are in the TabTty working tree.

Overall plan [#4](https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4).
